_comment: Paste these into your Retell (or Vapi) agent as custom tools/functions. Set the base URL to your deployed backend and add the header X-LumiDesk-Secret with your TOOLS_SHARED_SECRET. org_id should be set per-agent (one agent per business) as a constant argument or via the platform's dynamic variables.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Get open appointment times for this business. Call this before offering the caller specific times. Returns a list of slots, each with a machine time (iso) and a spoken time.

service.description: What the caller wants, e.g. 'burst pipe', 'haircut'.

days.description: How many days ahead to search. Default 5.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment at an exact time you already offered from check_availability. Creates the calendar event and texts the caller a confirmation. Only call this once you have the caller's name, phone number, and a chosen time.

start.description: The chosen slot's iso value returned by check_availability, e.g. '2026-09-22T08:00:00+03:00'.

call_id.description: The platform's call id, if available, to link the booking to the call.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send the caller a text message (e.g. an address, a link, or a message). Booking already sends its own confirmation, so use this only for extra messages.

to.description: The caller's phone number in E.164, e.g. +15550142.
